variants.en: Earth's gravity is zero at the International Space Station.
variants.zh: 地球引力在国际空间站处为零。

correction.en: Gravity at the station is still substantial; orbital free fall produces apparent weightlessness.
correction.zh: 空间站处仍有显著引力；轨道自由落体导致表观失重。

variants.en: The far side of the Moon never receives sunlight.
variants.zh: 月球背面从不受到太阳光照射。

correction.en: Both sides receive sunlight during the lunar cycle.
correction.zh: 月球两面在月相周期中都会受到阳光。

variants.en: Replacing the Sun with a black hole of identical mass would instantly pull all planets into it.
variants.zh: 将太阳换成相同质量的黑洞会立即吸入所有行星。

correction.en: At planetary distances the gravitational effect of equal mass is essentially unchanged.
correction.zh: 在行星距离处，相同质量的引力效应基本不变。

variants.en: Northern summer occurs because Earth is closest to the Sun in July.
variants.zh: 北半球夏季是因为地球在七月最靠近太阳。

correction.en: Axial tilt causes the seasons; Earth is closest to the Sun around January.
correction.zh: 地轴倾斜导致四季；地球在一月左右最靠近太阳。

variants.en: An egg can be balanced on its end only during an equinox.
variants.zh: 鸡蛋只能在春分或秋分竖立。

correction.en: Egg balancing does not require an equinox and can work any day.
correction.zh: 竖蛋不需要春分或秋分，任何一天都可能成功。

variants.en: NASA paid millions of dollars to invent the Fisher Space Pen.
variants.zh: NASA花费数百万美元发明了费舍太空笔。

correction.en: Fisher developed the pen privately; NASA later purchased it.
correction.zh: 费舍自行出资开发这种笔，NASA后来购买了它。

variants.en: Velcro was invented by NASA for spaceflight.
variants.zh: 魔术贴是NASA为太空飞行发明的。

correction.en: Hook-and-loop fasteners were developed independently of NASA.
correction.zh: 钩环粘扣的开发独立于NASA。

variants.en: Teflon was first invented for NASA's space program.
variants.zh: 特氟龙最初是为NASA太空计划发明的。

correction.en: Teflon predates NASA and was not a NASA invention.
correction.zh: 特氟龙早于NASA，不是NASA的发明。

variants.en: Sunlight appears intrinsically yellow even outside Earth's atmosphere.
variants.zh: 太阳光在地球大气层外也天生是黄色的。

correction.en: The combined visible sunlight appears white outside the atmosphere.
correction.zh: 太阳的可见光综合起来在大气层外呈白色。

variants.en: The Great Wall of China is clearly visible to an unaided observer on the Moon.
variants.zh: 从月球上用肉眼可以清楚看到中国长城。

correction.en: The Great Wall cannot be distinguished unaided from the Moon.
correction.zh: 从月球上无法用肉眼辨认长城。
